questions.text: Describe a foreign country you would like to visit.
questions.say: Thank you. Now, in Part 2, I'm going to give you a topic, and I'd like you to talk about it for one to two minutes. Before you talk, you'll have one minute to think about what you're going to say. You can make some notes if you wish. Here is your topic. Describe a foreign country you would like to visit. You should say: which country it is; how you know about it; what you would like to do there; and explain why you would like to visit this country.

questions.text: Who would you like to travel there with?
questions.say: Thank you. Who would you like to travel there with?

questions.text: Why do more people travel abroad today than in the past?
questions.say: Thank you. We've been talking about a foreign country you would like to visit, and I'd like to discuss with you some more general questions related to this. Let's consider first of all international travel. Why do more people travel abroad today than in the past?

questions.text: What problems do people sometimes have when they travel to another country?
